notes:
Training now has a time on it, and the people attending can see it.

A training session is booked from a moment to a moment rather than just on a
day. Pick the date and the time it starts and the time it ends; the list and
the card show both. A session with no time set still reads as a plain date, the
way it always did.

Seeing the schedule is its own permission now. Until today the Training page
was only for the people who run training. A Super Admin can switch "See
training" on for anyone, from the Permissions screen — they get the schedule in
their own menu, read-only: what is booked, when, and who is running it.
Scheduling, editing and cancelling stay with whoever runs training.

An L&D Manager gets the schedule without being given anything.

Alerts: swipe a card.

Swipe left to mark one read without opening it. Swipe right to delete it — that
one asks first, because it is the only thing on that screen you cannot undo
from the screen itself. An alert you have already read has nothing under a left
swipe, and only one card opens at a time.

Deleting an alert takes it off your list and leaves the record alone, so a
birthday wish somebody sent you is not destroyed by tidying your notifications.
